column1: # GadScape UI fixes (ui-fixes step, UiFixesStep): QA fixes of GadScape's own interfaces, applied after ui-merge and
# ui-convert on every build. Rows: IFACE<TAB>COMPS<TAB>ACTION<TAB>ARG<TAB>FINDING<TAB>NOTE; IFACE is the USER id (mapped
# through the id map), COMPS a list/range. Actions: set FIELD VALUE (int or str:TEXT; IfComp field names), move-hook FROM TO,
# drop-hook HOOK, hook-args HOOK N (keep the script and its first N arguments). Owner standard: no interface may be
# transparent, incomplete or without working buttons.
